notes.title: Wedding Day Walkthrough Part 3
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends! [/b]👋

Ready for Chapter 4 of Wedding Day? Here we go! 🎉



[b]1.Get two cups of tea🍵[/b]  
They are on the tables in the room directly in front of the spawn point and the room to the left. Make sure to grab the green ones! 🍃
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/1e48341f435e606f4e46a5f1e20029ee017d9dc2.gif[/img]


[b]2.Offering tea to parents[/b] 

Place the two cups of tea on the low table in front of the coffin (💡P.S. Don’t forget to pick up the lighter on the table along the way! )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/440391b0cd659da780e5b951ade6ef9f25fbd796.gif[/img]


[b]3.Get two candles[/b]🕯️

The first one is on the low wooden table🪵 in the room to the left of the spawn point—yes, the same room where you got one of the cups of tea. 
The second one is on the ground between the two closed rooms to the right front of the spawn point. There are also three wine jars🍶 there, you won’t miss it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/24712e45e31fdaa3ca3a66a93d855add3f404ac5.gif[/img]


[b]4.Lighting candles[/b]

Place them on the tables to the left and right of the coffin⚰️ and use the lighter we picked up in step 2 to light them. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/5c275bee3734a2c74cb2f13d501403ab0b90cd88.gif[/img]


[b]5.Crossing the brazier🔥[/b]  

Stand in front of the coffin and walk towards the 1 o’clock direction until you reach the end. The brazier is there. Place it in front of the coffin and light it. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/c5c089907ec87180096d500bd351da16c4acd3f6.gif[/img]



[b]Enjoy the game![/b] 🎮

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📬 
Thank you!

notes.title: Wedding Day Walkthrough Part 2
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends![/b]👋

Did you manage to find all the answers to these mysteries? 🔍 Now the second part of the walkthrough is ready for you! 📜


[b]1.It’s so dark here.[/b] 🌑

Grab the lighter🔥 and light all the braziers on the ground.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/56b8ac5b48686c563ec7cc4bc781855f8e2d35f7.gif[/img]


[b]2.A new brazier![/b] 🪔 

After lighting the other braziers, a new brazier will appear at the entrance of a room. Light it and don't forget to take the shoes inside. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/9701e32c6c7884258d823dc2ec68677e1b41869f.gif[/img]


[b]3.A handy tool.[/b] 🛠️ 

Find the crowbar in the room with the Buddha statue and use it to pry open the coffin. 
(💡Tip: You can’t get close to the coffin without the shoes! 👠)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/b968ba265035e545cbcc1e1352d9cf60e7e92016.gif[/img]


[b]4.Where should I put the shoes? [/b]🤔 

Hold the shoes near the coffin to get a hint. 💡
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/712d4a8145f13ba7df43c9ce3629b9484d76a15a.gif[/img]


[b]Hope this helps you out and enjoy the game![/b] 🎮

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧
Thank you!

notes.title: Wedding Day Walkthrough Part 1
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends![/b] 👋

How’s your experience with “Wedding Day” going? In case you are experiencing some difficulties, here are some tips💡for you:


[b]1.There’s a wall made of books 📚…[/b]

Do you notice anything missing in the middle of the wall? There’s a book on the chair next to the table. You can place it in the empty spot on the book wall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/1530c37e12e21a3ed534edb28df97d0700fa5deb.gif[/img]


[b]2.Why is there nothing on the second floor🧐? [/b] 

Pay attention to the floor. Use the lighter to light the candlestick on the floor to get the vase, then place it back on the shelf on the first floor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/8bc219c07a629d877920d88aca0eb88059e308a7.gif[/img]


[b]3.A lighter🔥[/b]

Pick it up and open it to see what happens.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/0deaf4d79d9c46cb253e8d2154772b7d8ddb8690.gif[/img]


[b]4.Something is missing from the bookshelf! [/b]

So where is the missing book? It’s on the floor next to the Buddha statue 🪷.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/71d5d1841ea7aaa3ee1c1a1af7cb4c9de31926c4.gif[/img]


[b]5.There’s a stool without a candlestick [/b]

Place the candlestick from the secret passage onto the empty stool and light it along with the nearby candlestick 🕯️.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101738/a64f39031ca35caba650cd8c57feab543e2c2863.gif[/img]


[b]Enjoy the game![/b] 🎮 

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime📧
Thank you!
